message: The other day, as the weather report warned of a storm heading our way, my family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. My son was busy insisting we should stock up on snacks—because, apparently, it's not a storm without a proper snack supply—and my daughter was debating whether to make a pot of chili or bake cookies. I just smiled and thought, "Well, at least we have this whole 'preparedness' thing down to a fine art of comfort food." It’s funny how a little storm can turn into a cozy family planning session. What’s your go-to comfort food when the weather gets rough? 🍲
